B01.expect: Confirm Li migration rather than collective host reconstruction; keep if phase-separated metastable environments are acceptable.
B01.construction: Author QE Config1 26-atom parent repeated 1x2x2 -> 104; partial Li ordering preserved. Caveat: Not the author-relaxed 104-atom cell; homogeneous x=0.5 phase is metastable.
B01.caveat: Homogeneous half-lithiated phase is metastable. Source 26-atom ordering is repeated, not author-relaxed 104-atom cell.

B02.expect: Look for Li changing crystallographic sites while CoO2 layers stay intact.
B02.construction: Experimental P2/m table reconstruction, 3x3x2 repeat. Caveat: Table reconstruction, not deposited simulation minimum.
B02.caveat: P2/m crystallographic reconstruction, not deposited NEB endpoint. Layered Li ordering is imposed.

B03.expect: Check whether diffusion is a Li hop; reconsider a magnetic/charge-aware potential for Mn-centric chemistry.
B03.construction: Experimental crystal table reconstruction with partial Li occupancy. Caveat: Mn valence/magnetism not encoded in geometry.
B03.caveat: Mn oxidation state and charge ordering are not captured by geometry alone.

B04.expect: Look for which extra Li migrates and whether host Ti–O framework remains spinel.
B04.construction: 177-atom author-deposited Li5+x NEB starting endpoint; one extra Li. Caveat: Starting endpoint not certified UMA minimum.
B04.caveat: Author-deposited starting endpoint (177 atoms) contains extra Li; strong starting provenance.

B05.mechanism: Li diffusion in Ta-doped cubic LLZO
B05.expect: Look for Li hops through connected sites, not wholesale lattice disorder.
B05.construction: 188-atom author POSCAR Li6.5La3Zr1.5Ta0.5O12; chosen cubic not amorphous. Caveat: Parent source geometry not certified UMA minimum.
B05.caveat: Author-derived cubic POSCAR; chemically ordered Ta placement may condition pathways.

B06.expect: Decide whether to model ordered-local jumps or disordered superionic transport; review new minimum and consider larger/disordered cell.
B06.construction: 52-atom native fully occupied ordered-S/Cl parent; no Li removed. Caveat: Order/disorder selection matters; no force certification.
B06.caveat: Old Lite minimum moves by 0.917 Å under UMA-S-1.2.1, crossing the 0.2 Å identity cutoff. Fully ordered S/Cl may suppress long-range Li pathways.

B07.expect: Confirm the relaxed lattice preserves LGPS and discovered events are Li-ion hops.
B07.construction: 50-atom author FPMD pfe_orig_1 frame 7, no repeat. Caveat: MD snapshot, source-force fmax about 1.32 eV/A, not a minimum.
B07.caveat: Original literature geometry is an FPMD frame, not a force-converged minimum; saved Lite viewer starts from a relaxed minimum.

B08.expect: Confirm Na-site hops and framework integrity in the relaxed model.
B08.construction: 80-atom author FPMD frame 27; retain skewed lattice. Caveat: MD snapshot, source-force fmax about 2.74 eV/A, not a minimum.
B08.caveat: Original geometry is a high-force FPMD snapshot; skewed cell should be preserved.

C01.expect: Check O surface hop / site exchange; confirm adsorbate coverage is desired.
C01.construction: 2x2 repeat of 3x3 four-layer Pt; four O retain 1/9 ML. Caveat: Reconstructed adsorption sites.
C01.caveat: Four O adsorbates at 1/9 ML; source-inspired site placement.

C02.expect: Check H adsorption-site hops; do not interpret as electrochemical HER without an appropriate environment.
C02.construction: 2x2 repeat of 3x3 four-layer Pt; four H retain 1/9 ML. Caveat: Electrochemical environment absent.
C02.caveat: Four H at 1/9 ML; no explicit electrode potential, water or solvation.

C03.citation: Lynch 2000 (Surface Science; the stored DOI was truncated)
C03.expect: Check whether CO stays molecular and whether cooperative coverage-dependent motion is intended.
C03.construction: 4x4 Pt terrace, four CO remain at 0.25 ML; 3 layers. Caveat: Reconstructed coordinates; not paper-relaxed.
C03.caveat: Four CO at 0.25 ML, not a single isolated CO; 56-atom slab.

C04.expect: Watch O–Cu binding and HCOO adsorption configuration; distinguish rotation, diffusion, decomposition.
C04.construction: Four HCOO in 2x2 enlarged 3x3 slab; 1/9 ML; vacuum +8 A. Caveat: Independent bidentate geometry.
C04.caveat: Four HCOO adsorbates at 1/9 ML; reconstructed bidentate geometry rather than author-relaxed structure.

C05.expect: Check that CO resides on the intended step sites; distinguish terrace and step processes.
C05.construction: 2x1 repeat; two CO; three-atom-wide terraces and bottom-six Ni planes fixed. Caveat: Surface steps intentional; adsorption reconstruction.
C05.caveat: Two CO adsorbates; 2x1 repeat and fixed lower Ni planes.

C06.mechanism: N2 adsorption / N–N dissociation on Ru(0001)
C06.expect: Inspect how a certified saddle connects the intact and dissociated states; the literature specifically studies a lying-down precursor before N-N cleavage.
C06.construction: Four upright N2 on expanded six-Ru-layer 6x6 slab; source-inspired coverage. Caveat: Adsorption positions guessed; N2 binding must be checked.
C06.caveat: Four adsorbed N2 molecules are intact in the seed minimum (N-N 1.143 A). Six saved other-minimum geometries show a dissociated N2 pair, e.g. m154 has nearest N-N separation about 4.70 A.

C07.mechanism: CH4 dissociation to CH3 + H on Ni(111)
C07.expect: If methane activation is intended, retain CH3+H and gas-phase CH4 as possible states but check a saddle actually connects them; replace the original 164-atom trial only by deliberate decision.
C07.system: CH3 + H on Ni(111), author final state (50 atoms; Lite's C07)
C07.construction: Lite uses the 50-atom author final-state cell, not the 164-atom trial in the seed bundle.
C07.caveat: 50-atom Lite seed is CH3+H, not the original 164-atom CH4 trial: C-H 1.11-1.12 A x3, fourth H 2.87 A away. Saved m250 has intact CH4 but carbon is about 4.92 A from nearest Ni, suggesting a gas-phase molecule rather than stable chemisorption.

L01.expect: Verify the local vacancy moves rather than merely surrounding Si symmetry breaking.
L01.construction: 64-site Si cell minus one Si; periodic origin displays vacancy at edge. Caveat: Constructed defect, not recovered author-relaxed geometry.
L01.caveat: 63-atom constructed Si vacancy from 64-site host; not author-relaxed source.

L02.mechanism: Interstitial H diffusion in BCC Fe
L02.expect: Check H tetrahedral-to-tetrahedral or octahedral hops; do not claim magnetic-DFT equivalence.
L02.system: H interstitial in BCC Fe (55; 0 fixed)
L02.construction: Fe54H tetrahedral H interstitial; all atoms translated so H near edge. Caveat: Magnetic state, precise interstitial stability unverified.
L02.caveat: 55 atoms Fe54H, H near tetrahedral site; Fe magnetism and precise site stability are unverified in the model.

L03.expect: Track vacancy via missing lattice O sites; verify reference rather than accepting COD title.
L03.construction: 3x3x3 host Sr27Ti27O81 minus one O; vacancy displayed at edge. Caveat: COD source title has a BaTiO3/SrTiO3 bibliographic mismatch.
L03.caveat: 134 atoms, 3x3x3 host minus one O. Bibliographic source title mismatch noted in provenance.

L04.expect: Check whether two opposite polarization minima actually exist; other local saddles do not establish switching.
L04.construction: 2x2x2 polarized perovskite; collective switching, no vacancy. Caveat: UMA polar double well and reverse basin unverified.
L04.caveat: 40 atoms, 2x2x2 polar perovskite. No vacancy. Physical interpretation requires opposite-polarization endpoints.

L05.mechanism: O vacancy diffusion in rutile TiO2
L05.expect: If isolated vacancy migration is intended, test a 3x3x2 single-vacancy cell (215 atoms), not an exact repeat containing two vacancies.
L05.construction: Ti36O72 host minus one O; vacancy displayed near edge. Caveat: Defect charge/spin/polaron modeling unverified.
L05.caveat: 107 atoms with c axis only 5.918 Å: strong potential for periodic defect-image coupling along c. Original build failed for mixed 214/107 atoms; final export repaired.

L06.expect: Keep for migration/reorientation; compare 251-atom 5x5x5+1 only if ideal straight crowdion is required.
L06.construction: 129 W in 128-site BCC host, analytical crowdion-like core, near periodic edge. Caveat: Independent unrelaxed construction, not authors' DFT coordinates.
L06.caveat: 129-atom 4x4x4+1 crowdion-like seed relaxed to an inclined split interstitial; observed 0.172–0.180 eV translation and ~0.220 eV reorientation in old Lite.

L07.expect: Check proton transfer and OH reorientation separately; note strong dopant proximity and small supercell.
L07.construction: Ba8Zr7YO24H, 12.5% Y charge compensation; proton near boundary. Caveat: Proton/Y positions constructed; not author-relaxed state.
L07.caveat: Ba8Zr7YO24H, 12.5% Y dopant; proton and dopant positions constructed.

O01.expect: There is CO2-like bond formation in the saved geometry set, but verify which saddle connects it to CO + lattice oxygen; enlarge short lateral dimension only if artifacts matter.
O01.construction: 2x2 slab, two CO on one face, diagonal separation; reduced coverage, central fixed. Caveat: 6.21 A shortest lateral cell; finite-size effect not tested.
O01.caveat: 220 atoms and short lateral repeat 6.212 A; intact CO seed C-O 1.159 A. Five saved other minima (m012-m016) have a surface O-C-O-like fragment with C-O distances about 1.21 and 1.33 A.

O02.expect: Look for formation of a new O–O bond, not only rotation or desorption; specify whether electrochemical model is required.
O02.construction: 2x2 slab with oxygen-rich termination on BOTH faces; central fixed. Caveat: Exact electrochemical/spin/PES unavailable; optional product excluded.
O02.caveat: 272 atoms; oxygen-rich termination on both faces. Electrochemical potential / surface redox not modeled by coordinates alone.

O03.expect: Confirm water stays at the vacancy and reaction is dissociation, proton transfer or migration as intended.
O03.construction: Six-Ti-trilayer 4x2 model, water + bridging O vacancy near side; bottom fixed. Caveat: Unpassivated UMA alternative, not source pseudo-H surface.
O03.caveat: 290 atoms with a bridging vacancy and one H2O; saved minimum has two O–H distances ~0.974 and 0.995 Å.

O04.expect: Check vacancy location and O-site exchange; treat Ce redox energetics cautiously.
O04.construction: p(3x4), three O-Ce-O trilayers, only bottommost 12 O fixed. Caveat: Ce3+/DFT+U localization not encoded.
O04.caveat: 107-atom ceria slab with only 12 bottom O fixed; Ce3+ and DFT+U localization not specified.

O05.mechanism: Bulk O vacancy diffusion in SrCoO3
O05.expect: Check O-vacancy transport and bulk composition; do not move this into oxide-surface group.
O05.construction: Sr27Co27O80 3x3x3 fully periodic vacancy; bulk group, retain ID O05. Caveat: Co spin/redox and literature migration supercell unverified.
O05.caveat: 134-atom fully periodic SrCoO3-x (no slab); old-to-new seed maxdev 0.175 Å. Co magnetism / oxidation can control vacancy barriers.

O06.mechanism: CO2 and formate (HCOO) on hydroxylated In2O3(110)
O06.expect: Treat as a distinct formate state; relabel in viewer and avoid mistaking it for CO2.
O06.system: In2O3(110) with CO2 or HCOO (two author intermediates)
O06.caveat: Author HCOO intermediate. Carbon is bonded to H (1.113 Å) and two O (1.268, 1.279 Å). The source explorer incorrectly calls this CO2.

O07.expect: Check whether O–H transfer / dissociation occurs and whether 0.5 ML is the desired regime.
O07.construction: 4 molecular CH3OH on 4x2 terrace; 0.5 ML; six bilayers, bottom six planes fixed. Caveat: Slab thickness/mask/placements are proposed, not author-relaxed.
O07.caveat: 216 atoms with four molecular CH3OH, each has C–O ~1.442 Å, at 0.5 ML. Old-to-new seed maxdev 0.172 Å.

O08.expect: Check water adsorption/proton transfer; review fixed central layers and magnetic/redox validity.
O08.construction: 2x2 single-Fe termination, one-sided H2O at 0.25 ML; center 13/21 atomic planes fixed. Caveat: Water orientation unrelaxed; asymmetric slab intentionally.
O08.caveat: 143 atoms, 92 fixed; H remains bonded to O in saved minimum. Fe magnetic states and surface termination may matter.
